notes.title: Studio closure
notes.notes: [p]Good day all, I'm sorry to say that NoTime Studios will be shutting down indefinitely. As a resultant we must retire our games. This means that they will no longer be available for purchase and the storefront will be removed from the Steam.[/p][p]It has been a privilege to make games for all of you. [/p][p]Barry and I (Brayden) will still be kickin' around and making games in some form but this chapter has sadly come to an end. [/p]
